raw_text: Guys, this 'surgical strike footage' making rounds is literally from a Bollywood movie released last year. I recognize the exact scene. You can see the production house watermark in the bottom right corner at 0:23 if you look at the full resolution version. The actors are wearing movie costumes, not actual military gear. The CGI explosions are a dead giveaway too. Classic Bollywood realism.
clean_text: Reddit user identifies viral surgical strike footage as Bollywood movie scene. Production house watermark visible at 0:23. Movie costumes and CGI explosions identified.
